acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using TEEJARTI ("the Platform"), you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. These Terms and Conditions apply to all users of the platform, including entrepreneurs, investors, and business brokers.

platform.title: 2. Platform Description
platform.content: TEEJARTI is a business discovery and investment platform that connects entrepreneurs and investors across Oman and the GCC region. The platform facilitates business listings, investment opportunities, and professional networking.

userResponsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.intro: As a user of the platform, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate and truthful information in all business listings and profiles
Maintain the confidentiality of your account credentials
Comply with all applicable laws and regulations in your jurisdiction
Respect the intellectual property rights of others
Use the platform for legitimate business purposes only
Complete the KYC (Know Your Customer) verification process when required

verification.title: 4. Business Listings and Verification
verification.content: All business listings are subject to review and verification by our team. We reserve the right to reject, modify, or remove any listing that violates our guidelines or contains inaccurate information. Users are responsible for ensuring all financial and business information provided is accurate and up-to-date.

privacy.title: 5. Privacy and Data Protection
privacy.content: We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. Your personal information will be used solely for the purposes outlined in our Privacy Policy and will not be shared with third parties without your explicit consent, except as required by law.

financialTransactions.title: 6. Financial Transactions and Due Diligence
items: TEEJARTI facilitates connections but does not provide financial advice
All investment decisions are made at your own risk
Users must conduct their own due diligence before any financial transactions
We are not responsible for the accuracy of financial information provided by users
All transactions are conducted directly between parties

prohibited.title: 7. Prohibited Activities
items: Posting fraudulent, misleading, or false business information
Using the platform for money laundering or other illegal activities
Attempting to circumvent our verification processes
Harassing or engaging in inappropriate conduct with other users
Uploading malicious software or attempting to hack the platform
Creating multiple accounts to deceive other users

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: TEEJARTI shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform. This includes but is not limited to financial losses, business interruption, or loss of data. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you for using our services.

intellectualProperty.title: 9. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All content, trademarks, and intellectual property on the platform are owned by TEEJARTI or licensed to us. Users retain ownership of their business information but grant us a license to display and promote their listings on the platform.

termination.title: 10. Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend user accounts at our discretion, particularly in cases of terms violations, fraudulent activity, or legal requirements. Users may also terminate their accounts at any time by contacting our support team.

governingLaw.title: 11. Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman. Any disputes arising from the use of this platform shall be resolved in the courts of Oman.

contact.title: 12. Contact Information
contact.intro: For questions or concerns regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact us:

changes.title: 13. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Users will be notified of significant changes via email or platform notifications. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about our platform and services.

howToList.question: How do I list my business for sale?
howToList.answer: Simply create an account, complete the verification process, and submit your business listing with detailed information. Our team will review and approve qualified listings within 24-48 hours.

businessTypes.question: What types of businesses can I find?
businessTypes.answer: We feature businesses across all industries including retail, manufacturing, technology, healthcare, hospitality, and more. From small local businesses to large enterprises across the GCC region.

fees.question: Is there a fee to use the platform?
fees.answer: Basic browsing is free. We charge a success fee only when a transaction is completed through our platform. Premium features and enhanced listings have separate pricing tiers.

verification.question: How do you verify business listings?
verification.answer: We conduct thorough due diligence including document verification, financial review, and legal compliance checks. Only verified businesses are featured on our platform.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about TEEJARTI

whatIsTeejarti.question: What is TEEJARTI?
whatIsTeejarti.answer: TEEJARTI is a premier business matchmaking platform that connects business owners and investors across Oman and the GCC region. Our platform facilitates business sales, partnerships, and investment opportunities.

howDoesItWork.question: How does TEEJARTI work?
howDoesItWork.answer: Business owners can list their businesses for sale or partnership opportunities. Investors and potential buyers can browse listings, contact sellers, and arrange meetings. Our platform provides secure communication and verification services.

isTeejartieFree.question: Is TEEJARTI free to use?
isTeejartieFree.answer: Yes, browsing listings and basic account features are free. We offer premium services for enhanced listing visibility and additional features for serious sellers and investors.

howToListBusiness.question: How do I list my business on TEEJARTI?
howToListBusiness.answer: Create an account, complete the KYC verification process, then use our "List Your Business" feature. Provide detailed information about your business, including financials, location, and asking price.

whatDocumentsNeeded.question: What documents do I need to list my business?
whatDocumentsNeeded.answer: You typically need business registration documents, financial statements, tax returns, and any relevant licenses. Our KYC process will guide you through the specific requirements.

howLongListingActive.question: How long will my listing remain active?
howLongListingActive.answer: Standard listings remain active for 6 months and can be renewed. Premium listings may have extended durations and enhanced visibility features.

canEditListing.question: Can I edit my business listing after posting?
canEditListing.answer: Yes, you can edit your listing at any time through your dashboard. Changes are reviewed and updated within 24 hours to maintain listing quality.

howToInvest.question: How do I start investing through TEEJARTI?
howToInvest.answer: Create an investor account, complete KYC verification, and browse available opportunities. You can filter by industry, location, investment amount, and business type to find suitable matches.

minimumInvestment.question: Is there a minimum investment amount?
minimumInvestment.answer: No, there is no platform-imposed minimum. Investment amounts vary by business and are set by individual sellers. You can find opportunities ranging from small startups to established enterprises.

investorProtection.question: What protections do investors have?
investorProtection.answer: We provide KYC verification for all users, secure communication channels, and guidance on due diligence. However, all investment decisions are independent, and we recommend professional legal and financial advice.

kycProcess.question: What is the KYC process?
kycProcess.answer: Know Your Customer (KYC) verification involves submitting identity documents, proof of address, and relevant business credentials. This ensures platform security and builds trust between users.

kycHowLong.question: How long does KYC verification take?
kycHowLong.answer: KYC verification typically takes 1-3 business days. Complex cases or additional documentation requests may extend this timeframe. You will receive email updates on your verification status.

forgotPassword.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
forgotPassword.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page and enter your email address. You will receive a password reset link within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.

supportedBrowsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
supportedBrowsers.answer: TEEJARTI works best on modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend keeping your browser updated for the best experience.

mobileApp.question: Is there a mobile app?
mobileApp.answer: Currently, TEEJARTI is a web-based platform optimized for mobile browsers. A dedicated mobile app is in development and will be available soon.

dataSecurity.question: How is my data protected?
dataSecurity.answer: We use industry-standard encryption, secure servers, and follow strict data protection protocols. Your personal and business information is never shared without your explicit consent.

faq.contactSupport: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our support team is here to help.

what.title: What are Cookies?
what.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and enabling certain features of our platform.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable basic features like page navigation, access to secure areas, and form submissions.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enhance your experience by remembering your choices and providing personalized features.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website, allowing us to improve our services and user experience.
analytics.usage: Page views and user interaction tracking

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.authentication: To keep you logged in and secure during your session
howWeUse.preferences: To remember your language and display preferences
howWeUse.functionality: To provide personalized features like saved listings
howWeUse.analytics: To analyze website usage and improve our services
howWeUse.security: To protect against fraud and maintain platform security

managing.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managing.content: You have control over which cookies you accept. Here are your options:

browser.title: Browser Settings
browser.content: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block cookies, delete existing cookies, or receive notifications when cookies are set.

platform.title: Platform Settings
platform.content: In your TEEJARTI account settings, you can control functional cookies related to personalization and saved preferences.

note.title: Important Note:
note.content: Disabling essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website and prevent you from using certain features.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We may use third-party services that set their own cookies. These services include:
thirdParty.analytics: Analytics services for website performance monitoring

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "last updated" date.

contact.content: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us:
